name: Repeated Outbound Connections to a Single External Host (Beaconing)
description: Many network flows from one internal host to one external destination in a short window — the shape of C2 check-ins. Threshold-based; a low-and-slow beacon may need a longer interval or a ratio/entropy job.
query: network.direction:("egress" or "outbound" or "external") or (source.ip:(10.0.0.0/8 or 172.16.0.0/12 or 192.168.0.0/16) and not destination.ip:(10.0.0.0/8 or 172.16.0.0/12 or 192.168.0.0/16 or 127.0.0.0/8))
false_positives: Software update checks, telemetry, and SaaS agents (allow-list their destinations).
note:
### Triage
- Resolve `destination.ip` — reputation, ASN, age of domain.
- Look at flow regularity (fixed interval = automated) and `source.bytes` vs `destination.bytes`.
- Identify the process/user on `source.ip` from host telemetry.
